name: trend-only-subsignals-120m-slow-trend-periods
rationale: Internal pattern. Trend-only's gross edge has been window-dependent (+2.98 pp at 10m on 2026-11-07, +2.06 pp at 60m on 2026-11-10, -0.05 pp at 60m and +0.76 pp at 120m on 2026-11-13). The trend sub-signals use sma 200 / ema 100 / MACD 52-104-18 one-minute bars (1.7-3.3 h horizons), which turn over faster than a 2h rebalance cadence, so each decision samples a trend reading that is mostly noise relative to the holding period. Doubling every trend period (sma 400, ema 200, MACD 104/208/36) matches the trend horizon to the 120m cadence. Prior 'trend-family-beyond-5h-horizons' tested longer horizons only under the old reversion-dominated weights, never with trend-only weights.
code_change_summary: In TradingEngine::compute_btc_target (src/trading/engine.rs), set TREND_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 0.25 to 1.0 and REVERSION_SUBSIGNAL_WEIGHT from 1.0 to 0.0, and return None if weight_sum <= 0.0 -- identical to experiment/trend-only-subsignals-120m-threshold-015 (2eebab4); cherry-picking that branch's compute_btc_target commits is fine. Update the doc-comment NOTE to name this hypothesis. Update compute_btc_target_* tests' expected values where they legitimately change (rewrite, never delete) and keep the RSI-only -> None regression test. Run with --warmup-candles 450 (not 300) for this variant at all three capitals since sma_period is 400, and state that in the report; also run the plain 120m config (2eebab4 weights, default periods) at 500k as an unregistered reference.
constraints: This hypothesis modifies the body of TradingEngine::compute_btc_target. This change MUST be made only on this hypothesis's own dedicated isolation: "worktree" branch -- never as a direct commit to dev/main.
MUST NOT change TradingEngine::compute_btc_target's signature (its parameter list or return type) -- only its body.

MUST NOT change any individual sub-signal's own formula or the aggregation expression; exactly two numeric constants change (TREND 0.25 -> 1.0 and REVERSION 1.0 -> 0.0). Because REVERSION becomes 0.0 the weighted-mean denominator can be zero when only RSI/%B are present (partial warmup): handle that by returning None when weight_sum <= 0.0, and document it.

MUST pass `cargo test`, including the compute_btc_target_* unit tests in src/trading/engine.rs -- update their expected values if the new weight legitimately changes them (do not weaken or delete a test just to make it pass).

A promoted change still becomes its own PR against dev (per the pipeline's step 6) and is never merged automatically -- a human reviews it like any other algorithm hypothesis. Flag explicitly in the PR description that this diff touches compute_btc_target's body, so the reviewer gives it the scrutiny an allocation-formula change deserves.
MUST NOT touch src/exchange/bitflyer/*, .github/workflows/*, or anything on the live order-submission path.
